project.name: ai-pushgate
project.description: A language-agnostic push gate for regular git push workflows. An installed pre-push hook delegates into a managed Pushgate runner so local checks and AI review can fit the normal `git push` flow before changes reach the next layer of review.

layers.name: Project Contract And Release
layers.description: Package metadata, repository documentation, release automation, generated distribution entrypoints, and public project contract files.

layers.name: CLI And Push Workflow
layers.description: Command-line entrypoints, git hook integration, argument parsing, user-facing errors, and pre-push workflow orchestration.

layers.name: Configuration And Schema Validation
layers.description: Configuration loading, normalization, constants, error reporting, schema validators, schemas, templates, and fixture inputs.

layers.name: Path Policy And Git State
layers.description: Changed-file detection, diff parsing, path filtering, git command helpers, and target branch resolution.

layers.name: Process Execution
layers.description: Reusable process execution helpers for inherited, timed, captured, and provider command invocation.

layers.name: Local AI Review
layers.description: Provider registry, Claude and Copilot adapters, review prompt/context construction, guardrails, transcripts, output normalization, and verdict rendering.

layers.name: Deterministic Runner
layers.description: Deterministic push gates, configured tool commands, policy summaries, and transcript rendering.

layers.name: Documentation And Refactor Plans
layers.description: Product docs, issue plans, and staged refactor plans that explain or guide Pushgate architecture changes.

layers.name: CI Distribution And Automation
layers.description: GitHub Actions workflows, build scripts, installer support, and distribution automation.

layers.name: Test Suite
layers.description: Node test suites, harnesses, fixtures, and test support files that verify Pushgate behavior.

tour.title: Project Contract
tour.description: Start with the README and package manifest to understand Pushgate as a git pre-push gate with deterministic checks and provider-backed local AI review.

tour.title: CLI And Hook Entry
tour.description: Follow the installed hook and CLI dispatcher into the pre-push workflow that decides whether a push proceeds.

tour.title: Configuration Loading
tour.description: Review how v2 configuration is loaded, normalized, validated, and surfaced through the public config facade.

tour.title: Changed File Policy
tour.description: Trace target branch resolution, git diff parsing, path filtering, and public path-policy composition.

tour.title: Deterministic Gate
tour.description: Inspect how built-in policy checks and configured tool commands are evaluated before local AI review runs.

tour.title: Process Execution Boundary
tour.description: Look at the new process helpers that centralize command execution, timeout handling, inherited stdio, and output capture.

tour.title: Provider Commands
tour.description: Follow the local AI provider boundary through registry selection, provider configuration, Claude/Copilot adapters, and shared command execution.

tour.title: Review Context And Verdict
tour.description: Study how Pushgate builds review context, renders prompts, applies guardrails, parses output, writes transcripts, and turns provider results into push verdicts.

tour.title: Distribution And Templates
tour.description: Connect the build scripts, generated runner, starter templates, and distribution docs that package Pushgate for installation.

tour.title: Tests And Refactor Plans
tour.description: Use the tests and staged refactor docs to see how the new module boundaries are verified and where the next deepening steps are planned.
